statement: A source placement selects exactly one original profile per copy and a unique integer-Y cell. Assign precisely those cell flags. Complete source faces enforce disjoint filled outers inside stock, so the independently verified per-cell band minima obey every capacity. All cog copies have identical angle sets and stock domains and can be relabelled with their profiles in x order. For each ordered profile pair, the source-specific whole forbidden rectangle contains every nonnegative integer deltaX below the threshold at every allowed relative Y, hence each spacing bound follows from the original clauses. Every coordinate/profile witness extends to these flags; conversely every new witness satisfies all original stock and collision clauses. No prior profile-count exclusion is transferred.
